notes: εἰ δὲ μήγε → *Or else* is one noncompositional unit under rule 39, headed on the first particle.

πόρρω → *a great way off* is headed on *off*; heading on *way* remains defensible and is arguably closer to rule 34's treatment of *afar off*, where *off* is called the adverb's own particle, so a later reader may prefer the nominal.
τά takes the supplied nominal *conditions* under rules 22 and 102; the prepositional complement keeps its own preposition and noun.
